executive_summary: Maven build failed with 43 compilation errors due to missing Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, Jakarta Persistence, and Apache Commons dependencies. The project requires adding spring-boot-starter-security, spring-boot-starter-data-jpa, and commons-lang3 dependencies to pom.xml to resolve all compilation failures.

errors.message: Missing Spring Security packages: config.annotation.web.builders, config.annotation.web.configuration, config.http, security.web
errors.root_cause: Spring Security dependency is not included in pom.xml. The SecurityConfig class requires Spring Security packages that are unavailable.

errors.message: Missing Spring Data JPA packages: org.springframework.data.jpa.repository, org.springframework.data.domain, org.springframework.data.repository.query
errors.root_cause: Spring Data JPA dependency is not included in pom.xml. Repository interfaces require JpaRepository, Pageable, Page, Query, Modifying, and Param annotations.

errors.message: Missing Jakarta Persistence package and annotations: @Entity, @Table, @Id, @Column
errors.root_cause: Jakarta Persistence API is missing. Entity classes require JPA annotations which are provided by spring-boot-starter-data-jpa.
errors.fix_recommendation: The jakarta.persistence dependency will be included automatically when spring-boot-starter-data-jpa is added to pom.xml.

errors.message: Missing Apache Commons Lang3 package: org.apache.commons.lang3
errors.root_cause: Apache Commons Lang3 dependency is not included in pom.xml. ValidationUtils requires StringUtils or other commons-lang3 utilities.

summary: 4 dependency errors found affecting 43 compilation failures
